translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Toagun Saengi Monofitimi pwe Oawte Mae
Noan eew oat aekkaerhai aeremas re fioangei ngaeni Jesus mmweneer re Galilee kkewe Pilate eniir noa reen oatowe refang aar maenigaech ngaeni Deus.
Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Reen iga e ina wusun aar mae noa iir re Galilee kkena, nge aaemi oaw niuwaennei pwe remae pwe ekkaein monofitiir memmweer oanongeer noa re Galilee kaan?
Aapw saapw ina! Ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe ngaere igine oawse toagun saengi monofitimi, nge aaemi oawpwe pwan maegin mae noa.

Nge aeremas kkewe seig me waniman ikkiwe remae noa oatowe e ppiungiutiw iimw taegias we Siloam wooar? Oaw niuwaennei pwe remae pwe ekkaein monofitiir memmweer oanongeer aeremas kena reno noan Jerusalem?
Aapw saapw ina! Ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe ngaere igine oawse toagun saengi monofitimi, nge aaemi oawpwe pwan maegin mae noa.”
Fioang Awewen Eew Fig Iwe Ese Uwa
Iwe Jesus a aengaeniir fioangon awewe een: “Eno erhai mwaaen ne e menaw tae eew fig me noan menaai na aan. Egiut uwaen fig we nge esooar minne e rhuungi.
Iwe a aengaeni rhooan menaai we naiun pwe, ‘Een pipiiy, a enuuw raeg aaei itto giut uwaan fig eei, nge esooar minne i rhuungi me wooan. Een gopiy tiw! Meeta ipitaen aan itto foat wooan ppweon eei?’
Nge rhooan engaengaen menaai we a aengaeni pwe, ‘Soawumwaer, nigiti mwo reen eew raeg pwe ipwe genengi pwaeniaeniy fetaeneei mwo nge iya iseis nong koyasiun.
Nge ngaere enoa raeg iiy nge a yor uwaan ina nge a mwamwaai; ngaere esooar, ina nge wonaaen gopiy tiw.’ ”
Jesus a Aecchipwa Aaen Semwaai Erhai Rhooapwut Wooan Sabbath
Wooan Sabbath nge Jesus a fenai noan eew wutteer Jews.
Erhai rhooapwuton pwiuneoi we a seig me wanuuw raeg aan semwaai pwe eno erhai aniu aenneew wooan; eppwoar sagiuriun nge ese mmwenen iutae.
Oatowe Jesus enoa weri nge a faingiwow, “Rhooapwut mwuun, wopwene saenetaeg me reen oamw semwaai!”
A iseni tae paiun wooan niewe, nge noan oaton we rhag nge a uwen tae nge a aepingepinga Deus.

Soamwoonin wutteer Jews we a soong wooan Jesus pwe igiwe e aecchipwa rhooapwut we wooan Sabbath, a kkepas tae nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Wonowu raaen raaenin aarh sipwe engaang; iwe ina epwe noa itto raaen kenaan nge oawwa itto aecchipwaar rhooa semwaai, nge saapw wooan Sabbath!”
Soamwoon a paniuwaeni pwe, “Maan oatupwutupw! Aaemi oawmmwenen pwaeisi naimi wakke ngaere donkey me noan gurur nge oawwa paeniir noa oawpwe noa aiuniiur rhan wooan Sabbath.
Igina ina eno erhai rhooan aeinang we aaen Abraham ina a seig me wanuuw raeg aaen Saetan geoni; sisoapw saeneti nieen wooan Sabbath?”
Aessefaaenin kkepas we aan a aessaewaar noa rhooa kkewe rhooan kkoapwuton, nge aeremas towunap ra faer igin pwapwa reen oanongaen min mwamwaai kkewe efeeori.
Fioang Awewen Faiun Mustard we
Jesus a aeiyeg pwe, “E ifa wusun minna Mweoiun Deus? Meeta minne ipwe awewe ngaeni?

E ieen wusun. Erhai mwaaen a pwigi efai faiun mustard nge a noa foatogi noan menaai we aan. A pwaech miniwe faiun nge a temoag noa pwe efoarh waniwan, nge man aeniaen ra itto ffeeor feseer wooan raaen.”
Fioang Awewen Eew Yeast
Jesus a pwan aeiineo, “Meeta minne ipwe awewe ngaeni minna Mweoiun Deus?
E ieen wusun. Erhai rhooapwut e pwigi egius yeast nge a nofiti fengaenniy me enuuw pwaecchin fenoawa emas toori aan pwo tae fenoawa we.”
Asam we e Rheogit
Jesus a toonong noan aepinoamw kkewe me pwugos kkewe, nge a fenai fetaen aeremas igiwe e nennoa ngaeni Jerusalem.
Erhai a aeiineow pwe, “Soawumwaer mwuun, aekkaerhai rhag minne repwe menaw?” Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe,
“Oarhorho pwe wopwe faer nong noan asam na e rheogit; pwe iga re towunap aeremas repwe aeginaar nong nge resoapw takkenong.

Miniwe soamwoonin iimw we epwene iutae nge a ttiy noa asam we; iwe oawpwene iu nasam pwe oawpwene apiungiupiung nong wooan asam nge oawwa iura pwe, ‘Soawumwaer, sugi mwo asam!’ nge iiy epwe paniuwaeni gaemi pwe, ‘Ise giuneei igine aaemi oaw itto me ee!’
Nge aaemi oawpwene paniuwaeni pwe, ‘Aemaem aei mwongo me iun me reemw; een wo fenaiuw noan miniwe aepinoamwomaem!’
Nge iiy epwene pwan iura sefaaeniy pwe, ‘Ngaang ise giuneei igine aaemi oaw itto me ee. Oawsiu noa me oaroi, oanongaemi rhooa wegitaeg aenneew!’
Ifa mwo aaemi pwe sessaeng me akkaarengi, igine oawpwene weriir Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, me oanongeer profeta kkewe me noan miniwe Mweoiun Deus, nge aaemi oawwa faer aekkaerh noa!
Aeremas repwene maegeto me eotiw me netow, eor me efaeng, iwe ra itto mooat tiw noan gupwunnap na noan Mweoiun Deus.
Iwe aaemweoi re amwirimwir repwene gommw, nge aaemweoi regommw repwene amwirimwir.”
Aaen Jesus Aerhaengerhaeng Ngaeni Jerusalem
Noan oatowe rhag nge aekkaaemweoi Pharisee ra itto reen Jesus ra aengaeni pwe, “Wopwene siu me igeei wa noa eew pwiuneoi, pwe Erotes a mwerhaen epwene niug noa.”

Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Oawnoa oawwa noa aengaeni maan oatupwutupw na pwe: ‘Ipwe oatowowuw mwuniaan nge i arhiuwa aar semwaai aeremas igina me naiu, nge wooan ayeoniuraenin raaen nge a moann aaei engaang.’
Inamwo nge ngaang ipwene noa raaeneei, naiu, me raaennenaan; pwe ese ffin pwe erhai profeta epwe noa mae me eew pwiuneoi pwe noan rhag Jerusalem.

“Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Wa niir noa profeta kkewe, nge wo teraar rhooan pweipwogin kkepas kkewe Deus efangeto reemw! A faaen fiteig aaei mwerhaen pwe ipwe ioni fengaenniy noawumw aeremas, taeppen maniug a ioni fengaenniy naiun faaen paiun, nge een wose mwerhaen pwe ipwe feeori!

Iwe Temple we oamw ina aeremas repwe siusaengi iwe peonoa. Ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe aaemi oawsoapw weriaei no toori oatona oawpwe iura pwe, ‘Deus epwe aewenepwuwa aeremas na epwe itto faaen itaen Soamwoon.’ ”
